activities.anchor: The first modern lens was a method, not a doctrine
activities.caption: pair each formalist concept with its claim
activities.name: litFormMatch

config.prompt: The text alone — pair the concept with what it asserts:

pairs.right: art exists to make the stone stony — to slow perception past habit
the author's biography is not the poem
the reader's feelings are not the poem either
irony, paradox and tension resolved within the words on the page

config.why: This gave literary study its laboratory method — close reading — and everything since has been a series of expansions of what counts as 'the text'.

activities.caption: file each finding under the code it exposes
activities.name: litStructBuckets

config.prompt: Saussure's system of differences, applied — file each finding:

items.label: Propp's 31 functions and seven character roles — Cinderella, Bond and Star Wars share a grammar
Genette's formalisation: who speaks versus who sees; order, duration, frequency
absentation, violation, struggle, return — the functions a folktale runs through

config.why: The lens finds the deep code beneath the story — and was then famously self-applied: if meaning lives in systems of difference, no system can close.

activities.caption: find the line deconstruction would undo
activities.name: litPostSpot

config.prompt: One line of this poststructuralism summary is wrong — click it:
lines: 'The Death of the Author' (1967) detached the text from authorial intention.
Différance: meaning endlessly deferred from signifier to signifier, never anchored.
Intertextuality (Kristeva): the text is a tissue of quotations.
Deconstruction claims texts mean nothing at all.
If meaning is not fixed, the fixed meanings that serve the powerful are choices — and can be contested.
config.correction: Deconstruction is a disciplined demonstration that a text's hierarchies (speech over writing, presence over absence, man over woman) are undermined by the text's own logic.
config.why: The move licenses scrutiny, not anything-goes — readings are argued from evidence within systems.

activities.anchor: reads literature in its material relations
activities.caption: pair each political lens with its case
activities.name: litPolyMatch

config.prompt: Whose experience does this serve? Pair the lens with its question or case:

pairs.right: what ideologies the form naturalises — Jane Eyre's plot needs a woman upstairs and servants downstairs
reconstructed the lost tradition of women novelists
the 'angel/monster' split — Bertha Mason as Jane Eyre's double
the West's textual 'East' as a construction that justified rule
Conrad's Africa as a prop for a European psychology — a reading that permanently changed how the text is taught

config.why: Butler radicalised the lens — gender performatively produced by repeated acts, literature one of the machines of that production — and the question is always whose experience the text makes normal and whose it makes marginal.

activities.anchor: The mirror-image lens: instead of the author,
activities.caption: drag the divider — what the text gives, what the reader brings
activities.name: litReaderCompare

config.prompt: Reader-response splits the completion — drag the divider:

before.label: What the text supplies
before.text: Iser's gaps: a novel never tells us the hero's face — but the gap itself is structured by the text.

after.label: What the reader brings
after.text: Jauss's horizon of expectations; Fish's interpretive communities — the same words compose different poems for different communities, and 'the text itself' is the product of the reading, not its source.

config.why: Readings are constrained and arguable — which is exactly why a class can divide and then argue productively. The lens relocated meaning; it did not abolish standards.

activities.anchor: A formalist close reading dissolves that
activities.caption: true or false — reading Frost's road
activities.name: litFrostJudge

statements.s: The poem's two roads were worn 'really about the same'.
statements.why: The close reading that dissolves the bold-individualist reading starts here.

statements.s: 'I took the one less traveled by' is a straightforward factual report.
statements.why: It is spoken by a narrator who admits he will be telling it with a sigh, ages hence — a self-flattering story projected onto an undecided choice.

statements.s: Frost actively cultivated the individualist misreading in public readings.
statements.why: The 'author function' is itself a constructed object — even the authorial context is curated material, not ground truth.

statements.s: The four lenses compete for the single correct meaning of the poem.
statements.why: They locate different strata — one sixteen-line poem, four findings.

activities.anchor: Run the structuralist lens on a tale every culture variants of
activities.caption: line up Cinderella through Propp's functions
activities.name: litProppOrder

items: Interdiction and villainy — the stepmother's exclusions
Mediation — the ball invitation: the hero learns of what she lacks
The magic helper's gift — the fairy godmother
The mark of recognition — the lost slipper
Solution, return and reward — the fitting, then the wedding
config.why: Swap the surface — Yeh-Shen's fish-bone helper (ninth-century China), Rhodopis and the eagle (ancient Egypt), the Ash Lad (Scandinavia) — and the sequence persists: different costumes, same grammar. The limits are equally visible: the lens sees the skeleton and says nothing of who gets to be the magic helper rather than the hero.

activities.caption: choose a working method — settlement and countercurrents
activities.name: litWarsBranch

config.root: A decade of new novels lands on your desk. Which method do you work with?

choices.label: Close-read with a named, historically informed lens
choices.feedback: The current synthesis: most working critics do exactly this — one lens at a time, worn and named.

choices.label: Chart all of them — genre counts by decade
choices.feedback: Distant reading: data across thousands of titles — the rise and fall of genres, the novel's spread.

choices.label: Ask what the books do for their readers
choices.feedback: Postcritical reading: attachment, enchantment, recognition — against the reflex that finds domination under every surface.

synthesis.text: The canon arguments permanently widened syllabi to women, global and minority writers — and left this pragmatic settlement behind.

moretti.text: Franco Moretti's trade: close reading for data — a quantitative lens the digital humanities are still extending.

felski.text: Rita Felski, The Limits of Critique (2015): the hermeneutics of suspicion is a habit, not the whole of reading.

config.why: Each addition stays in the kit rather than replacing its predecessors — the discipline's arc in miniature.
